kinetic_criterion: For legacy physical-mass relaxation: K / max(abs(U_elastic+U_stabilization), 1e-24 J) <= 1e-6; separate from force and strain drift.
drift_criterion: Range of active bond strain over the preceding 50 mechanical steps divided by peak strain; scalar max/mean ranges also included; maximum <= 0.01.
scipy_unknowns: Free particle coordinates represented as (x_free-X_free)/h; fixed coordinates excluded.
scipy_residual: Flattened free particle total force divided by max(initial external force L2,1e-12 N); scaling changes neither load nor the force-balance root.
scipy_acceptance: SciPy reports success AND independently recomputed relative force residual <=1e-4. This does not assert ADR verification.
erosion_rerun_gate: Do not run before mechanical solver verification, including ADR/reference comparison, is complete.
window_sweep_initial_condition: Identical undeformed X and zero v, D=0, immutable g=1, same physical density/dt/damping/mean flow.
parallel_jobs: Resource-limited process pool; one directory and log per job; three workers initially by hardware budget.
